scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./index.html --outdir=dist --minify && cp -R src/app/styles/fonts dist/fonts && cp src/fixtures/snapshot.json dist/snapshot.json

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: bun run biome check --staged --no-errors-on-unmatched && if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then gitleaks git --staged -v --redact --no-banner; fi
simple-git-hooks.pre-push: bun run lint && bun run lint:yaml && bun run lint:suppressions && bun run typecheck && bun test --pass-with-no-tests && if command -v actionlint >/dev/null 2>&1; then actionlint -color; fi && if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then gitleaks git . --log-opts="$(git symbolic-ref --quiet --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD || echo main)..HEAD" -v --redact --no-banner; fi && rm -rf reports/mutation && bunx --no-install stryker run && bun scripts/mutation-floor.ts && { bash scripts/diff-budget.sh || true; }
